page_title: reminal: your machines, in any browser

summary.name: reminal
summary.one_liner: Reminal lets you view and control the windows, desktops and terminals on your own machines live from any web browser.
use_cases: Control a Mac at home from a browser
Use a phone as a trackpad for a remote computer
Run a terminal on a cloud machine alongside a local editor
Launch and operate installed apps on a host remotely
Access a full remote desktop without opening ports
summary.what_it_does:
Streams individual app windows or the full desktop of a host machine live into a web browser. Users can click, type, scroll, drag, right-click, pinch-zoom and select text in the streamed window as if using the machine directly. Installed apps on the host can be launched from an Apps menu and then driven. On a phone the screen acts as a trackpad. Windows can be popped out of the browser tab to sit on the local desktop as separate app windows.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">unknown
notable: Drive any app window in a browser, not just view it
Phone screen works as a trackpad
Pop out a streamed window to sit on your local desktop
Works with lid closed and no open ports, per page description
